_doc: Ore fields (round 1 playtest, play/ore.js). Credits and GAME seconds. Each field sits around its extraction rig (the ore mine). field_total: starting (and maximum) ore by deposit kind. load_rate: one harvester's loading rate (capacity 500 / load 10 s). regrow_share: regrowth per field as a share of load_rate (0.05 = 2.5 credits per game second); the Settings slider scales it 0-4x. spread_min / patch_rate / core_m: regrowth creeps outward from the rig (a patch regrows only when its inner neighbour holds spread_min of its maximum, at most patch_rate of its maximum per second). Patches: 4 m nav cells within field_radius_m of the rig that a harvester can drive onto; richness falls off toward the rim (falloff, noise) and the rim is scattered (edge_gaps).
